'''Outpost Talarn''' was an outpost owned by [[House of Thul|House Thul]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and affiliated to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. At this outpost were stationed [[Dathis Elgin]], Medical [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Willem]], [[N5-R3]], Officer [[Jeral Vesk]], Sergeant [[Pratt]], Sergeant [[Tegan]].
